properties.name: Essential Education
properties.description: Since 2002, Essential Education has empowered over 4.5 million adults to reach their life goals through award-winning online learning systems and print materials. A one-of-a-kind solution, Essential Education is specifically designed to help adult learners accelerate Skills Gains. Our innovative programs transform adult education by addressing the diverse needs of adult learners—from low-level adult basic education to high school equivalency test preparation, and workforce readiness skills. Thoughtfully designed to support educators in achieving impactful outcomes, our programs provide guided pathways for each student, seamlessly enhancing both traditional classrooms and virtual learning environments.
